# Revora (sellrepairphone.org)

Revora is a quality mobile repair and phone buyback service based in Mumbai, India. We specialise in reviving dead phones, micro-soldering, liquid damage recovery, and offering assured cash for pre-owned or broken devices.

## Key Services
- Instant Phone Buyback: Sell old, broken, or completely dead phones (iPhone, Samsung, etc.) for payment via UPI or bank transfer.
- Lab Bench Repair: Specialized micro-soldering for dead logic boards, data recovery, and hardware faults.
- Standard Repair: Same-day screen, battery, and camera replacements.
- Pre-Loved Flagships: Shop certified 100-point inspected refurbished iPhones and Galaxy phones with 1-year shield warranty.
- Doorstep Service: Free secure pickup and drop available across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane.

## Guarantees
- 100% Data Security: We execute NIST 800-88 military-grade 3-pass hardware wipe on working phones, and physically destroy memory chips on dead boards before recycling.
- OEM Level Components: We use genuine components or quality equivalents.
- Transparent Pricing: Our estimators provide fixed upfront repair/sell quotes based on live market pricing.
